tools.name: compare_cruise_lines
tools.description: Side-by-side cruise lines for the same kind of cruise (a region, departure port or port visited, plus dates): each line's number of sailings, ships, median and lowest price per person per night in one cabin grade, and its cheapest sailing with book_url. Answers "Alaska in July: Princess or NCL?".
